title: smime-tree error.rs: SmimeError does not implement Eq — only PartialEq
description: SmimeError is #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)] but not Eq. The reason: SmimeError::Der(der::Error) where der::Error may not implement Eq. Tests and callers that want to use SmimeError in assert_eq\! or as map keys cannot. Idiomatic Rust: implement Eq manually (since PartialEq is already correct, and Eq is just a marker). Or check whether der::Error now implements Eq in the locked version.
